subject: AWS Marketplace: credentialing evidence asks + product page copy sync
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecloud.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-marketplace@aws.amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing prep — credentialing and copy questions

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We have a tight window to get the AWS listing live for our joint pilot (internal target: Oct 1). AWS onboarding asked us to submit credentialing evidence and the product page copy in parallel. Two asks from their team: 1) a completed credentialing spreadsheet (SOC2, data residency, KMS/HSM, logging/audit paths) and 2) final product page copy (short description + key feature bullets + AMI/PrivateOffer footnotes).

Attached is the SOC2 evidence spreadsheet they've provided — can your team confirm which items Redwood can provide and which we need to supply on our side? Also, we did a first pass on the listing copy and would love Redwood's voice/claims check — keeping it tight for the hero and avoiding platform-level legal language.

Attached: soc2-evidence-request.xlsx, product_one_pager.pdf

Appreciate a quick triage so we can loop AWS and schedule the doc submission.

Best,
Sanjay
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Acme Cloud

---
Sanjay Rao
Acme Cloud | sanjay@acmecloud.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-marketplace@aws.amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing prep — credentialing and copy questions

Thanks Sanjay — looping in Kimberly and Tessa to own the evidence and copy items. Quick plan:

- Kimberly: take lead on the SOC2/data residency/KMS evidence mapping and confirm which artifacts we can provide from Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private offerings.
- Tessa: please review the product page copy and suggest concise hero + three bullets that reflect the performance + cost controls differentiator.
- I will coordinate the submission window with AWS and confirm who signs the attestation.

Kimberly and Tessa — Sanjay attached their draft and the AWS spreadsheet. Can we get a first-pass confirmation by EOD Monday (9/14)? If anything needs legal or security sign-off, flag it here.

Alex
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing prep — credentialing and copy questions

Quick update and attached notes (listing_copy_comments.md + filled portions of soc2-evidence-request.xlsx):

- SOC2/evidence: Redwood can supply the following within 48 hours: SOC 2 Type II summary report (redacted), network diagram for Redwood Private (region scope), KMS integration guide (we use customer-managed keys for Private deployments), and API access logs retention policy. Items we cannot provide: customer-specific config screenshots (we can provide templates) and Acme-managed AMI signing receipts (Acme responsibility). See the attached spreadsheet; I added a column for "owner" and timelines.

- Product page copy: I edited the hero and bullets for AWS tone, suggested a 250-char short description and three bullets focused on: 1) predictable production latency, 2) reserved capacity + burst options (dedicated), and 3) deployment parity across hosted/dedicated/private. Avoided mentioning internal kernel/quantization details — AWS legal flagged that before. See listing_copy_comments.md.

- Attachments: uploaded soc2-evidence-request_filled.xlsx (partial), listing_copy_comments.md, product_one_pager.pdf (annotated).

Next actions: Alex to confirm who signs the attestation; Sanjay to confirm which AMI/PrivateOffer artifacts Acme will provide. After that we'll submit to AWS Marketplace team.

Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Integrations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Nice work, Kimberly — a couple of quick copy tweaks from field: shorten bullet 2 to "Reserved GPU capacity with predictable throughput" and add a micro-example under the bullets referencing a typical request profile ("e.g., 50 qps, 512-token avg, 99th pct latency <150ms"). Sanjay — if you can confirm AMI access and PrivateOffer terms by EOD Wednesday we can submit the package to AWS and request the expedited review window.

I will also surface the attestation owner in our partner ops meeting — leaning to Redwood partner ops signing infrastructure items while Acme signs customer-specific AMI packaging.

Tessa Morgan
